title: Relocation preserves fuel runs
statement: For any Boolean loop body and fuel machine, input word, fuel-machine configuration $c$ on that input, and time $t\in\mathbb{N}$, running the relocated fuel source for $t$ steps from the relocated configuration of $c$ equals the relocation of the fuel machine's configuration after $t$ steps from $c$.
replaced:
Let $c$ be a configuration of the fuel machine and $t$ a time. Running the relocated
fuel source for $t$ steps from the relocated embedding of $c$ equals the relocated
embedding of the fuel machine's run from $c$ at time $t$.
